Name: Mikey's Greenhouse
Author: mekkanikmike
Description:
Version 1.2.1 Minor upradate!!!

Entry is now at the bottom of the green house between the two rooms. There are now two exits at the top of the green house that put you back outside. You can just blitz through if you need. As always, comments welcome...

Version 1.2.0 Update!!!

I've added a selectable second layout that you can use to plant just all the multi yield crops, in addition to five small flowerbeds, as well as space for 25 sunflowers and two large areas for Rare seeds and Starfruit. It gives you the option of having a small, yet diverse planting option. It's also VERY tractor friendly. The mod also supports generic mod config menu where you can change your layout. 

PLEASE BE ADVISED: [b][i]Empty your greenhouse before you switch layouts[/i][/b]. Otherwise, the game will try to draw the old contents on top of the new layout and you'll have, well, weird results. Check the image gallery for the new layout.

Coming soon (hopefully)
- A cellar where you can stuff in your casks. 


I've mucked about with tons of greenhouses, but always kept coming back to the comforting greenhouse of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5344]Jen[/url]. I've loved the minimalism afforded and the practicality of a 25x15 fully tillable plot and two trellis lines. However after 1.5 came out and the fruit trees increased to 8, I wanted six more tree spots, plus a small place to set up a winery. So with Jen's kind permission, I extended her base green house just a wee bit. (Well maybe a bit more.)

What this features:
- Everything that is in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5344]Jen's simple greenhouse[/url].
- This should be fully compatible with all mods that the original works with.
- This uses the spring tile sheet for the interior, so it's gonna be pretty much the same season inside all year.﻿

In addition:
- Tree spots (increased to 24, 3 of each in the base game,) have been moved to a smaller east wing, with a central open area for setting up a brewery.
- No untillable 'sprinkler placeholders.'
- 5 3x5 planters for vanilla game flowers.
- Two trellis rows collapsed into a single planter.
- Perfectly suited to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2917]Line sprinklers[/url] (be sure to use the [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-14#post-21916]rebuild for 1.5[/url]). (My preferred config is 5/10/25 for all three kinds of sprinklers. I'll be frank. The original is also perfect line sprinkler friendly. 
- Also tested with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7456]Greenhouse sprinklers[/url]. Perfectly free to move about without any line sprinklers getting in the way. Cheers!!

What I use:
I pair this mod with:
- [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-14#post-21916]Line sprinkers[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5180]PFM Upgraded Kegs[/url] (They got both kinds: with and without quality bonus. you can pick which ones you want.)
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7456]Greenhouse sprinklers[/url] 

I did try to make this compatible with pressure nozzles in Ir Sprinklers but that makes the central plot too huge for my taste. ﻿Besides, Line sprinklers don't support pressure nozzles, which will open another can of worms. If you have any ideas for other variations, do let me know. I am open to making this configurable and giving 2-3 options to chose from. 

[i]DO NOT use this mod with a planted green house. Your stuff will NOT migrate properly. Empty it out and then install the mod. Be sure to, you know, un-till everything with the pickax as well [/i]:)
